Model details

What happens under the hood

  • The system uses TF-IDF vectorization with 100,000 unigram and bigram features to convert textual content into numerical feature vectors that machine learning models consume.
  • Three individual classifiers were evaluated on the held-out research test set: Multinomial Naive Bayes (91.17% Macro F1), Logistic Regression (94.05% Macro F1), and LinearSVC (94.49% Macro F1).
  • Ensemble experiments (Soft Voting at 94.15% Macro F1 and Stacking at 94.47% Macro F1) did not outperform the standalone LinearSVC baseline on the held-out test set.
  • A LinearSVC classifier (C=0.5) evaluates maximum-margin decision hyperplanes learned during training across all six domains and was selected as the final production inference model.
  • The classifier predicts the most decisive domain by comparing hyperplane distances, producing an exact label plus an operational decision margin for uncertainty estimation.
  • After prediction, the FastAPI backend automatically sorts the uploaded file into the matching local desktop folder so the UI can display a concrete storage path.
About

Real-world usefulness & intelligent automation

Why it matters

Knowledge workers routinely drown in mixed-format inboxes. This project demonstrates how lightweight NLP plus disciplined folder hygiene can scale personal organization without manual tagging.

Machine learning lens

Every upload exercises a full machine learning stack: selection, cleaning, transformation, modeling, and evaluation through margin and lexical diagnostics surfaced on the results dashboard.

Presentation ready

The interface keeps the pastel DocuSense palette, soft glass cards, and smooth motion so judges or interviewers immediately read it as a modern AI SaaS experience—not a homework script.

AI-powered cross-domain document classification and auto-sorting system for demos, vivas, and portfolio storytelling.
